Every message carries a zero-knowledge membership proof and a nullifier; attempting duplicate messaging releases consistent Shamir secret shares that reconstruct the private key, triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. One bonded identity therefore cannot safely spawn Sybils, while harbor, vine, and fable are only labels.
